text: The Bangkok Metropolitan Administration developed its own Urban Heat Management Action Plan for 2026, with 22 indicators and a committee chaired by a deputy governor.

text: Its targets include cooling rooms in 80% of schools and public health service centres, at least 100 Cool Community Centers, at least two cooling points in every district, and home visits to at least 5,000 vulnerable households a year during heat alerts.
